title: Identification of neutrophil extracellular traps-related genes for the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction based on bioinformatics and experimental verification.
summary: Machine-learning screening nominated NFIL3, MMP9 and S100A8 as neutrophil-extracellular-trap-related acute-myocardial-infarction candidates. The study reports rat-model RT-qPCR and western-blot corroboration; these checks do not establish clinical diagnostic utility.
ai_technology: Machine-learning screening of transcriptomic data prioritizes NET-related candidate genes for experimental follow-up.
organization: Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Jinan, 250014, China

evidence.tested: The abstract and Results identify NFIL3, MMP9 and S100A8; rat-model RT-qPCR and western-blot assays provide experimental corroboration.
evidence.unknown: Human clinical diagnostic performance and prospective clinical utility remain unestablished
